title: Exact Codimension-Two Reaching Thresholds for Binary Completely Reachable Automata — Reproducibility Package
description: Reproducibility package for the exact codimension-two reaching threshold theorem in binary completely reachable automata. Version 1.0.1 is a manifest-only correction: the paper PDF, theorem, n=8 verifier, and frozen verification result are unchanged from v1.0.0; the integrity manifest covers stable publication artifacts and excludes mutable CI workflow files.
